errors: GATE BEFORE PHASE 4 — unresolved cross-spec collision with specs/usb-stick-hotplug/. Both features rewrite Reload, scanSlides, and Run()'s empty-directory contract, and both touch main.go wiring. usb-stick-hotplug also makes s.interval runtime-mutable, which races advanceDuration on the main goroutine, and currently treats a video-only USB stick as 'no supported images'. Sequence the two features or jointly architect ownership of those three surfaces before invoking sdd-coder on either. Detail in CriticReview.md, first section.
